notes: §1985:XI.2.3.4 GR1: 'The ASSIGN clause specifies the association of the file referenced by file-name-1 to a storage medium referenced by implementor-name-1 or literal-1'; the content of implementor-name-1 and value of literal-1 are the implementor's (§1985:VII.2.3.3 SR3), here DOC-A.1-71. AssignTargetRule.Resolve reads the TO list for the SD's SELECT; the SD's storage medium is the run unit's sort work store, and SortEmitter.EmitAssociation adds a run-time association only for the dynamic USING form, which VisitAssignClause refuses below 2002 (COBOL0900). Probes at 85: witness (ASSIGN TO "SORTWK") and ASSIGN TO DISK "SORTWK" sort and print AAAAA/BBBBB; ASSIGN USING data-name -> COBOL0900 (runs at 2002); ASSIGN written twice -> COBOL2423; empty TO -> COBOL0312; no ASSIGN -> COBOL5701; TO 123 -> COBOL5506; TO SPACE -> COBOL2645 (§1985:VII.2.3.3 SR3 'must not be a figurative constant'); three operands -> COBOL2256, the documented DOC-A.1-71 latitude. Classes a, d (record forms), e, f do not reach an association rule with no data operand.

next.reason: 1985: "to a storage medium referenced by implementor-name-1 or literal-1."; 2023: "identified by device-name-1, literal-1, or the content of the data item referenced by data-name-1". Same ASSIGN association rule, but 2023 adds the USING data-name-1 case. It fixes association at OPEN, SORT or MERGE time and makes the statement unsuccessful on inconsistent content.
